propositions: Record a durable Architecture Decision Record (ADR 0100) documenting the RP-05 CLI redesign before implementation, including lazy route registry, stdlib-only argparse factories, deterministic help generation, and capability enforcement.

Establish a single immutable top-level command registry with lazy handler and parser-factory module:function references, with pre-operation routing (help/alias/unknown) before config, mount, handlers, or optional imports.
Define semantic capability registry with error/unavailable/abstain/fallback postures, mapped to packaging extras, enforced only after selected mode/backend is known.

Preserve exact/compatibility/hidden/retired alias taxonomy with shared argument helpers for bridge shims and historical jira-onboard commands, without introducing docs-only grammars or Click/DI dependencies.
Validate ADR 0100 numbering, generated index, links, and document oracles (check_adr_numbers.py, gen_adr_index.py --check) before Gerrit Submit with explicit maintainer approval.
Update docs/architecture.md with implemented CLI boundary and link to ADR 0100, without copying historical rationale or hand-editing generated artifacts.
